project.description: The unique id (or alias) of the project to build and publish.
project.title: project

tools.name: BuildAndPublishApp
tools.description: Compile a React or JavaScript app from assets/client, write the build output to assets/portals, and publish it. Use this after changing client source that requires a frontend build. Do not use it for a plain HTML app or when assets/portals already contains the complete runnable app. Use this at the end of any turn that edited source files. This is the only way to build — node/npm/pnpm are unavailable in the sandbox.
tools.title: Build And Publish App

project.description: The unique id of the project whose existing portal assets should be published.
project.title: project

release.description: Release the published portal so it is available from the public project URL. Set this to true.
release.title: release

tools.name: PublishProject
tools.description: Publish and release portal assets that are already runnable without compiling them. Use this for a plain index.html app or when assets/portals already contains the finished app. Do not use it after changing React or JavaScript client source that still needs to be built.
tools.title: Publish Project
